scope: Carbon gravel and all-road bikes and framesets available to riders in mainland China, generally with nominal tire capability above 38 mm.
buyer_note: Prices are dated observations or reference ranges, not live quotes. Verify the exact SKU, measured tire width, remaining clearance, component substitutions, serial number, and warranty before paying.
privacy: The dataset contains public product information, anonymized market observations, remote product-image URLs and credits, and original project placeholders only. It contains no buyer identity, account details, private messages, private screenshots, or personal permission correspondence.

frameset_build_assumption.label: standard China-market build
frameset_build_assumption.summary: A fixed allowance for a China-market electronic hydraulic 2×12 drivetrain, alloy wheels, tires, cockpit or finishing kit, and assembly.
